name: A larger pipe cannot fit through the same narrow gap
assumptions: This room and pipe are invented for testing. They are not extracted from the supplied ship drawings.
Millimeters are chosen for this example. The supplied drawings still have unconfirmed units.
The 50 mm clearance is a sample rule. It is not an organizer requirement.
The 250 mm diameter is the pipe outer diameter. Insulation is not modeled.
The room box is the permitted routing space. Only the listed boxes represent obstacles.
The centerline search uses a 250 mm grid plus fixed endpoints and inset boundary coordinates.
Each direction change adds 300 mm to the search score. This is a preference and not additional physical length.
This example represents one pressurized pipe. Drain slopes and fitting dimensions are not checked.
